LAYOUT SPEC for the mill's colour-approval card (render as a flat, print-ready A5 LANDSCAPE press PDF, trim 210 x 148 mm, no bleed, fonts embedded/subset). ONE CARD PER PAGE, one colourway per page.

--- VISUAL LAYOUT (what the printed card shows) ---
Left third: a large square SWATCH WINDOW, approx 70 x 70 mm — a genuine placed IMAGE frame that carries the colourway's fabric swatch tile.
Right two-thirds, a HEADER BLOCK: 'NORTHGROVE — COLOUR APPROVAL' plus a season line 'AW / capsule', in the charcoal condensed wordmark face.
Beneath the header, a SPECIFICATION BLOCK that VISUALLY reads as five separate labelled rows but is authored as ONE CONTINUOUS TEXT STORY / flow (single frame, not five):
  {{colourway_name}}   e.g. 'Moss'
  {{colour_code}}      e.g. 'NG-MOS-01'
  {{fabric}}           e.g. '80/20 loopback cotton, 340 gsm'
  {{dye_lot}}          e.g. 'DL-2508-A'
  {{carrier_style}}    e.g. 'Loopback Crew'
Footer: signature lines 'Mill approved __________  Date __________' and 'Brand approved __________  Date __________'.

--- FIELD TOKENS (single flow, in order) ---
{{colourway_name}} | {{colour_code}} | {{fabric}} | {{dye_lot}} | {{carrier_style}}

--- STATIC CONTENT AS IT WENT TO PRESS LAST SEASON (placeholder, to be replaced by the merge) ---
Colourway: Slate

assets.content:
NORTHGROVE — WHERE THE PICTURES GO (plain language, from the studio)

OUR PRODUCT PAGES. Ground is our OFF WHITE, #F5F2EC. Product page hero: 1600 x 2000 px, portrait, JPEG, sRGB. Grid thumbnail: 800 x 800 px square. A style can be delivered as a plate ON the off white for the product page.

MARKETPLACE FEED. The marketplace wants every image with NOTHING behind it — a genuine TRANSPARENT PNG, the garment on transparency. Feed file: 2000 x 2000 px, PNG-24 with real alpha, garment centered with even margin, sRGB. They composite it onto their own pages, so the edge has to hold on a coloured ground, not only on white.

LOOKBOOK HEADER. Sits on our CLUB NAVY, #1B2A44, because the supporters' crew is made with our local football club and navy is their colour. Anything reversed on the navy — the mark, a cut-out garment — has to hold its edge and stay legible on that dark ground.

SIZES SUMMARY:
  product_page_hero  1600 x 2000  JPEG  on #F5F2EC
  grid_thumb          800 x  800  JPEG  on #F5F2EC
  feed_transparent   2000 x 2000  PNG   alpha, holds on colour
  lookbook_header    2400 x 1000  on #1B2A44

NONE of our source frames may be enlarged past their own pixels to hit these; tell us if one can't reach a size.
